random.description: The image shows macroscopic gross pathology specimens of the large intestine (A and B) alongside a microscopic H&E stained tissue section (C). Panels A and B display segmental bowel involvement with strictures, fat creeping, and wall thickening characteristic of inflammatory bowel disease. Panel C demonstrates chronic inflammatory changes with non-caseating granulomas in the mucosal and submucosal layers. These combined macroscopic and microscopic findings are most consistent with Crohn's disease affecting the colon.
